interpretation_constraints.rule: HTTP success and captured bytes are transport custody only, not source admission, field classification, row terminalization, or class closure.
Generic federal policy or guidance cannot establish a state-specific operative authority, waiver interval, verification practice, or worker decision.
A state overview, toolkit, landing page, or index is not the complete operative manual, rule, policy version, or succession chain.
A time-limit or work-requirement statement is not a waiver request, approval, denial, geographic scope, start date, end date, or successor record.
A SNAP Employment and Training plan is program-design and planning custody, not a participant eligibility, exemption, fitness, verification, or sanction determination.
A listed exemption category or policy authority is not evidence that any individual qualified for, requested, received, or was denied that exemption.
A verification checklist, form, directory, portal, or manual section is not a completed verification record and does not establish which evidence was accepted.
A reference to worker judgment, reasonable explanation, collateral contact, or alternative evidence does not establish how discretion was exercised in any case.
A missing, moved, restricted, nonresponsive, or failed route is a typed source result and cannot be converted into policy, event, practice, or person-level absence.
Failure of the bounded public corpus to state a fact is not evidence that the underlying authority, waiver, procedure, practice, or event does not exist.
A result for Arkansas, Georgia, Maryland, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, or West Virginia cannot be promoted into national prevalence or complete fifty-state coverage.

Terminalizing any or all of the twenty-one selected substantive cells does not itself terminalize the seven derivative row-state cells, close RD-04-C02, change the cumulative ledger, or close Wave 03.
